statement: Every generic real quintic threefold has at least 15 real projective lines.

answer.qualification: Lower bound on ordinary real lines for regular fibres; no assertion that 15 is an attained minimum. The source uses dim(V)=5, so its projective ambient space has dimension 4.

source.location: Corollary 25, Section 3.3; take dim(V)=5 and k=2·5−5=5

origin.inheritance_basis: In Corollary 25 take dim(V)=5, so P(V)=P⁴ and k=2·5−5=5. The multiplicity-weighted bound is 1·3·5=15; for regular lines every local multiplicity is one, giving the ordinary count bound.

notes: Corollary 25 gives an algebraic multiplicity-weighted bound for isolated real lines. The ordinary count bound follows for regular fibres, where each local multiplicity is one. Attainment of 15 is not asserted.
